name: Consistencia de Mechones de Cabello
description: Analiza la consistencia de hebras de cabello individuales en video
algorithm: Hair Strand Consistency — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes hair strand temporal consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **Strand Flow Extracción**: Oriented texture analysis extracts the dominant hair flow direction across the hair region per frame. Hair strand orientation maps capture the directional structure of the hairstyle.

2. **Flow Temporal Consistencia**: Hair strand orientation should change smoothly and coherently across frames — strands move together as connected structures following physical dynamics. The method tracks orientation map consistency. Deepfake generators may produce incoherent inter-frame strand flow, where hair directions shift independently without physical motivation.

3. **Strand Movimiento Physics**: Hair strand motion follows pendulum-like physics with characteristic frequency dependent on strand length and head motion. The method analyzes the frequency content of hair motion signals. AI-generated hair motion may lack correct physical frequencies or show overly smooth motion without natural oscillation.

4. **Cabello - Rostro Límite Consistencia**: At the hair-face boundary, hair strands should maintain consistent spatial relationships with facial landmarks (sideburns align with temples, bangs maintain forehead coverage). Deepfakes may show hair-face boundary instabilities where the independently generated face doesn't maintain proper spatial relationship with the original hair.

5. **Strand Rendering Consistencia**: The rendering quality of hair strands should be spatially and temporally uniform. The method checks for regions where strand quality degrades — AI generators may produce good strand rendering in some areas but degrade in complex regions (wind-blown hair, overlapping layers), creating detectable quality inconsistencies.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: estadística
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante hair strand consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
